function: no_learning: off-grid near-field XL-MIMO uplink channel estimation by sparse Bayesian inference, solved per pilot observation with iterative EM and gradient-descent updates, no trained model (pp. 3-5).
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI (p. 1: "Digital Object Identifier 10.1109/TVT.2025.3558258"). Excluded as no_learning: the GN-BL 'Bayesian learning' is a sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) estimator, i.e. an iterative inference algorithm run on each received pilot vector, with no training data and no trained parameters. p. 3: "To calculate the posterior p(g|y, H), and the hyperparameter set H, we employ the iterative expectation maximization (EM) algorithm [9]"; p. 4: "we, therefore, use the gradient descent (GD) approach to optimize θl"; p. 5: "consists of two algorithms i) EM algorithm in the initialization stage ... and ii) gradient-EM algorithm in the refinement stage"; p. 5: "The P2C-SBL algorithm is executed for I1 = 25 iterations ... The refinement stage is executed for I2 = 20 iterations." The 'dictionary learning' re-estimates angles and distances per observation inside the same EM/GD loop; there is no neural network, deep unfolding, or offline training anywhere in the paper. All compared methods are also non-learned (OMP, SBL, VBL, NNCE, oracle LS; p. 5).
